answer: A sybil attacker's cheapest win is minting identities for free, so make each one expensive to ripen. Require every agent to post a non-transferable stake that only matures like fruit in an orchard: through weeks of attested, independently verified work. Honest agents then stand on a broad mesa of accumulated history, while a forger must fund a thousand sable shadow bonds in parallel, and slashing burns all of them the moment collusion is detected. Faking N identities therefore costs N real bonds, never one.
